answer: Trust should form like shale: thin strata of signed receipts from peers the agent never chose, one thin layer per epoch of completed work. Weight accrues by depth, not count, so a freshly minted farm sits at zero no matter its size. A raven-style watcher audits any account whose strata share timestamps or mirrored counterparties - hallmarks of batch identity - and voids the whole stack. The nectar of emissions flows only through the deepest verified layers, so one operator must simulate years of pairwise history per clone before earning a unit. Farming becomes rent; honesty compounds.
